heroSummary: Northside ISD students begin the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026. The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Spring break is March 8–12, followed by a teacher planning day on March 15, so students return Tuesday, March 16. Students are off October 9–13, creating a five-day break including the weekend. February 16 is reserved as a possible bad-weather makeup day and should be confirmed before making plans.

calendarNotes: Northside ISD students begin school August 10, 2026, after teacher workdays August 3–7, and finish May 26, 2027. Students have a five-day break October 9–13. Winter break runs December 21–January 1, with a teacher planning day January 4. February 16 is a possible bad-weather makeup day. Spring break runs March 8–12, followed by a teacher planning day March 15. The district also lists a school holiday Friday, April 23.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The first student day moves from August 11 to August 10.
Students have no school October 9, 12, and 13, creating a five-day break with the weekend.
The last student day moves from May 21 to May 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of Northside ISD school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students’ first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026. Teachers have scheduled workdays August 3–7.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Northside ISD spring break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break is March 8–12, 2027. Monday, March 15 is a teacher planning day, so students return Tuesday, March 16.

calendarFaqs.q: Will Northside ISD students have school on February 16, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The date is reserved as a possible bad-weather makeup day. Students will attend if Northside ISD uses it to recover lost instructional time; otherwise, it will remain a student holiday and staff development day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official Northside ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link above. The separate ICS file is created by MySchoolDates and does not update automatically.

calendarFaqs.q: Is this Northside ISD in San Antonio or Northwest ISD near Fort Worth?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers Northside Independent School District in San Antonio, whose official website is nisd.net. Northwest Independent School District serves the Dallas–Fort Worth area and uses nisdtx.org.
